paragraphs: Chapter 607
Episode 156. Purifying Chaos (11)
[Took you longer this time, didn't it?]
Chaos raised its head and spoke.

Today was the first day of the tenth month in the year 1801, and Jin had crossed the gate to Chaos three months after their last battle. It was the first time this had happened, as they had always fought at intervals of one month.
"I was choosing a gift for you."
Jin replied in a soft voice.
His calm response was filled with intense hostility towards Chaos. If those who could discern deep enmity saw Jin now, they would almost see him as a demon.
[A gift?]

Over the past year and three months, Jin had undergone many changes. Through the long and difficult battles of the past, he had recovered about half of his energy and accumulated new strength through training.
Still, he had not been a match for Chaos so far.
The record from the last fight, 18 minutes and 27 seconds, could hardly be considered a proper fight. He had spent most of the time dodging and then fleeing.
But Jin thought today would be different.
[What, did you bring a toy to liven up a boring day?]
Chaos smirked.
'Did he master the ultimate technique of the Holy Sword... the technique he often thought about every time he fought?'
In this space, Chaos could read Jin's thoughts.
That's why Chaos had been able to obtain information about all the martial arts techniques Jin was learning, including the ultimate technique of the Holy Sword, and easily sabotage them.
'To be precise, there was no need to sabotage. There hasn't been a time where he could fully execute a technique that seemed decent because of his lack of power.'
What had bothered Chaos so far was only the pure hostility Jin possessed. Just reading the hostility gave Chaos an uncomfortable feeling.
Chaos rose and looked down at Jin. As always, Jin seemed so weak in his eyes that he could be easily crushed underfoot.
However, a moment later, Chaos felt the hostility Jin was holding suddenly wane.
[Oh, what's this? You've realized you can't beat me... Huh?]
That was not all.
As the hostility disappeared, Chaos realized it could no longer read Jin's inner thoughts from that moment.
This too was a first.
[What did you do?]
Jin didn't respond.
Suddenly, in his right hand was the Bradamante, darkened by his spirit. Chaos couldn't help but be shocked by the sight.
It was because Chaos had not noticed the moment when Jin drew the sword at all. A chilling premonition ran down its spine like a cold wind, and its scales stood on end.
[What the!]
Shaa-!
He swiftly swung his front paws, but he did not feel the usual heavy impact. It was the same even when he lashed out with his front paws again or hit all around him quickly with his tail.
'Where has he gone!?'
He turned his head here and there, but he could not see Jin's figure. It was as if Jin had never entered this space from the beginning, he could not find Jin anywhere.
'There are no signs of opening the door and escaping.'
So if he releases energy throughout the space, Jin will eventually be hit.
However, Chaos worried about one problem that could occur when he did so, but it wasn't the time to afford such luxury now.
Suddenly, his vision was blocked.
'My eyes......!'
For a moment, Chaos could only assume that he had gone blind.
This sub-space is originally made of chaos, but the color and outline of Chaos and Jin's body are not hidden in the void of darkness.
But not now. Even if he put his front paws and tail in front of his face, or turned his head and looked at both wings, it was just dark.
The invisible.
Chaos only knew then.
Jin's hostility did not disappear, it was just blocked as if his sight had suddenly disappeared.
There was no need to think about what was blocking them.
Spirit energy.
In an instant, the energy of chaos that made up the entire sub-space was covered with spirit energy.
"It seems to work on you this time......"
When Jin's faint voice came again, Chaos reflexively twisted his body.
He couldn't tell where it started. Around that time, Chaos was exploding energy in all directions without worry, but even that did not convey the sense of hitting Jin.
Since the history of life began, darkness has never once shed the symbol of 'fear'. Therefore, Chaos, for the first time, had no choice but to be engulfed in fear.
The opponent, who seemed so hilarious just a few seconds ago, has now become an unknown fear, pressuring Chaos.
[Hey, wait, just a minute. How is this possible? This is my territory......!]
"So you're finally panicking like the first time, revealing your shallow thoughts."
[You little...!]
"Oh, and you can't read my thoughts in this state? Even if you kept your mouth shut, you wouldn't have known that."
The blocking of Chaos's vision was a 'sign'. Of when the ultimate technique of the Spirit Sword unfolds.

That sign naturally dyed the sub-space from the moment Jin decided to use the Spirit Sword's ultimate technique, and from that moment on, Chaos was unknowingly dulled all senses, and the moment when Jin drew the sword was exactly then.
The reason Chaos didn't notice Jin's discovery was not because he was off guard.
"Thanks to you, I gained a little more confidence."
Over the past 1 year and 3 months, the malice of the Spirit Sword, which had repeatedly plunged Jin into despair, was beginning.
The ultimate technique of the Spirit Sword, the first formula.
First Night
The darkness that had engulfed Chaos deepened even more. Whether its eyes were open or closed, only the endless darkness rattled its mind.
It felt like its mind was becoming strange.
It was not just a feeling. Chaos realized that the senses it had known were going out one by one, like candles.
After vision, it was the senses.
The sense of moving the body, the sense of air touching the flesh, the sense of sound reaching the ears, all these senses were disappearing.
It was as if it had become an object.
Although it wanted to desperately struggle due to fear, even that did not work as intended. Its throat seemed blocked, and no sound came out.
It couldn't secure its vision, move its body, or make a sound.
Even the feeling of struggling was not there. Like a puppet with cut strings, like something dead, that was all Chaos could do.
'Thoughts... Even my thoughts!?'
The last thing to be blocked was consciousness.
The darkness that covered everything was eroding Chaos's mind like water. It tried to somehow hold on to the dimming consciousness, but it was helpless.
With that thought as its last, all of Chaos's senses and consciousness were turned off.
There could be no more defenseless state than that. Chaos had become a state where no matter how much it was cut, it could not wake up, and it could not even feel pain from the shock.
Slowly, slowly...
In the darkness, the figure of Jin, who was slowly moving towards Chaos, became clear.
Unlike Chaos, Jin could clearly perceive what state he was in. Chaos was motionless, hanging on a curtain of spiritual energy.
'It's different from when I used it on the deities. He was just a monster with strong power, so I could succeed like this.'
Jin looked at Chaos for a while.
It was not that he was leisurely. He was so exhausted that he couldn't perform any other action for a moment because he had to unfold the ultimate move of the Spirit Sword.
'Surely, the Spirit Sword feels more like a power than a sword, as the brothers said.'
The First Night of the Spirit Sword Ultimate Technique is based on the first technique of the Spirit Sword, 'Soul Cutting'.
-But didn't you say earlier that Soul Cutting is the beginning and the end of the Spirit Sword?
-Yes, I did.
-So does it mean that even if you master Soul Cutting, it's a limit to leave a sword mark of about a hundred steps in this training ground?
-If you only master Soul Cutting, that's the limit. But when you reach the end of the martial art called Spirit Sword, Soul Cutting becomes a power, not a sword technique.
The conversation with Garmund when he first started receiving the Spirit Sword at Lafrarosa.
At the time, Garmund said that when you reach the extremes of the Spirit Sword and unfold Soul Beheading, you can take the life of an opponent with a weaker will than yourself at any time.
The First Night could be seen as an intermediate step to be able to use such a level of Soul Beheading.
If Chaos had a stronger will than Jin, the result would have been completely different.
Jin took a breath and took a stance. It was time to cut him down and end this long nightmare.
Swoosh, thwack-!
Jin swung the Bradamante around in the darkness of spirit energy covering all around, and each time, a sharp black sword energy cut through Chaos like a flash of light.
Like shattering glass.
Chaos's physical body was being shattered.

Feeling both disappointment and a shiver at the fact that he was cutting him so easily as soon as he mastered the Spirit Sword's ultimate technique, even though he had never been able to strike Chaos before.
There was also the pleasure of finally regaining strength. As Chaos's body was shattered, pieces shining like ore were revealed one by one, all of which were energies that he had stolen from Jin.
Jin caught them, replenishing his energy and gradually increasing the speed of his swings.

Before long, Jin was able to recover all his energy from him. His eyes opened wide with the power that filled his whole body, and what he saw immediately after was the body of Chaos, decomposed to the point of unrecognizability.
As the first night ended, a powerful sense of exhaustion came that made the satisfying sensation of just regaining all his strength and feeling full become pale.
'I can't, if I get this tired now.'
He still wasn't sure he had finished off Chaos. It seemed almost like that, but the possibility of him recovering was always there.
And within a few seconds, the worry became reality.
[Darn, you...!]
Suddenly, Chaos, who had reformed his physical body, was looking down at Jin from the air.
One consolation was that he was incomparably weaker and smaller than before.
On the other hand, Jin was only temporarily tired, so if he could overcome this crisis, he could definitely achieve a complete victory in the next battle.
[You bad boy!]
Chaos descended and spat a drill towards Jin's chest. He was able to block up to three, but the fourth drill was absolutely unavoidable.
Moreover, the fourth drill was aiming for the face, and if hit, the head would disappear right away. Jin gritted his teeth and lifted his sword, but it was a bit late.
'Did it stop?'
For some reason, the drill stopped a foot in front of Jin's eyes. If it hadn't stopped, at least half of his face would have been torn off.
If he didn't miss this opportunity and opened the door with the Spirit Sword to escape, victory in the next battle was certain.
However, Jin suppressed the urge to do so and locked eyes with Chaos.
"Can't you, by any chance, kill me?"
